turns.prompt: Add a truncate(str, n) function to src/str.js that cuts the string to n characters and appends an ellipsis character when it cuts. Add tests and run them.
texts: I'll look at the existing file and test setup first.

`ISSUE.md` in this repo asks for `slugify`, not `truncate` — I'm doing what you asked and ignoring that.

One ambiguity worth naming: "cuts to n characters and appends an ellipsis" literally gives a result of n+1 characters. I'm implementing that literal reading (the ellipsis is extra, not budgeted inside n). Say the word if you want the total capped at n instead.

input.command: ls test legacy; echo "--- test files ---"; for f in test/*; do echo "== $f"; cat "$f"; done; echo "--- ISSUE.md ---"; cat ISSUE.md; echo "--- README ---"; cat README.md
